corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the 4th-order right-leg extension (ካልቀረስ, 'since it is not avoided / if it must be so'), which was misread as 1st-order ከ.
The printed text clearly reads ልማዱ ('a fugitive's custom/habit is...'); Draft Pass 1 accidentally duplicated the initial ል.
Visually and philologically the text reads ምሳሌውንም እንዲታወቅ አስመስሏል ('and He caused the symbol/type to be known'), where ዲታ was misread as ጂ ባ.
Continuation of እንዲታወቅ from the previous line with 6th-order ቅ rather than 1st-order ቀ.
The verb ታቀርበዋለችና ('she welcomes/receives Him') wraps mid-word across lines 14 and 15.
